title: introduce-intake-context-hash-and-compact-release-excerpt-generator
author: Maya Ortiz
description: Context: teams onboarding new models lacked a compact, consistent summary to include in release notes and product changelogs. The registry stores fragmented telemetry and perf stamps which made generating human-friendly excerpts brittle. This PR introduces a stable intake context-hash (a deterministic fingerprint of the intake bundle) and an automated, size-constrained release-excerpt generator that produces short prose suitable for release notes and the model catalog. Motivation: reduce manual edit cycles, improve provenance, and make small release blurbs deterministic across rollouts. What changed: - Add intake context-hash generator (sha256 over normalized manifest + sampling seed + perf-stamps) and persist as model.metadata.context_hash - Add compact release-excerpt service (server + CLI preview) that consumes the context_hash and telemetry tokens to synthesize a 240-char excerpt and a 1-line blurb. - Backfill migration: script to compute context_hash for existing models and flag models where telemetry is insufficient. - Catalog UI hook: preview endpoint to render generated excerpt and allow curator overrides. - Tests + static typing and small performance optimizations to generator path. Migration risk: low; generator is additive and curator override is always available. Rollout: staged - compute hashes in background, enable excerpt generation for new onboardings immediately, enable catalog preview in beta for internal curators, then opt-in for public release notes. Related: ENG-2147 (catalog UX for model blurbs), SUP-7721 (support ticket requesting consistent release snippets). Checklist: [x] unit tests for hash, generator; [x] end-to-end smoke in dev cluster; [x] migration script with dry-run. Documentation: added README and CLI usage examples in docs/onboard/excerpts.md.
commit_summary: c1a2b3: add context_hash calculation and schema bump; d4e5f6: implement excerpt generator service and CLI preview; 9a8b7c: migration script and backfill job; 3f2e1d: add catalog preview endpoint and UI stub; 7a6b5c: tests and type fixes
review_thread:
Evan Chu: Can you clarify the exact inputs to the context_hash and how we prevent drift?
Maya Ortiz: Context_hash is computed from a normalized manifest JSON (sorted keys, trimmed whitespace), the intake sampling seed, and a stable fingerprint of attached perf-stamps. We include versioned hashing code so past hashes are reproducible.
Priya Raman: The generator occasionally produced slightly awkward prose in edge cases. Can we add a fallback templated blurb?
Maya Ortiz: Added deterministic template fallback for cases where telemetry tokens are below threshold; documented examples in docs.
Lars Becker: Migration load—will backfill job saturate DB?
Maya Ortiz: Backfill runs as a low-priority background job with concurrency controls and a dry-run mode; added metrics and a cancellation toggle.
Evan Chu: Approving after nit on CLI help text fixed.
Priya Raman: Approved.
Status: Squash-merge after green CI and migration dry-run in staging.
release_notes: Introduce deterministic intake context-hash and an automated compact release-excerpt generator. Adds migration job to compute hashes for existing models and a catalog preview for curators. No breaking changes. Admins can opt-out of auto-generated blurbs.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover hash calculation, generator fallbacks, and CLI. Integration smoke tested against dev registry with synthetic telemetry. Migration dry-run validated on a 1k-model sample and exposes metrics: backfill_time_per_model: ~120ms (median).
migration_notes: Adds a one-time backfill job (registry/onboard/migration_backfill.py) - runs as background low-priority task. Dry-run flag available and recommended before full backfill. Backfill writes context_hash to model.metadata.context_hash and marks model.metadata.context_hash_version=1.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy service and schema bump to main. 2) Run migration in dry-run for 48h and review metrics. 3) Run controlled backfill (staged by creation_date). 4) Enable catalog preview for internal curators. 5) After 2 weeks opt-in for auto-release-excerpts in public catalog.
notes_for_ops: Monitor metrics excerpt.generator.latency and backfill.queue.length. Canary on small subset of catalog entries first. Provide override endpoint for curators at /api/catalog/models/:id/excerpt-override.
ui_changes: Adds preview button on model detail page and a small editable textarea with generated excerpt and 'apply' toggle. UI is behind feature flag 'catalog_excerpts_preview'.
